subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should soft steer be a resumable pause-and-inject feature, or should active non-streaming runs use an explicit abort-and-replace contract while boundary steering remains the default?
rationale: The choice determines user-visible cancellation semantics, partial-output treatment, tool safety, session ownership, and whether a new queue/config mode is necessary; source inspection cannot safely choose that product contract.

options.title: Specify an explicit active-run contract
options.body: Document streaming, tool-execution, cancellation, partial-output, and follow-up behavior, then revise the linked implementation to meet it.

options.title: Keep safe-boundary steering only
options.body: Retain current boundary-oriented steering and close the broader resumable-continuation request as intentionally unsupported for now.

options.title: Adopt abort-and-replace for non-streaming runs
options.body: Allow the linked approach only with explicit user-facing cancellation and session-state semantics rather than presenting it as transparent continuation.

recommendation.title: Specify an explicit active-run contract
recommendation.body: Document streaming, tool-execution, cancellation, partial-output, and follow-up behavior, then revise the linked implementation to meet it.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion shows direct review of the relevant lifecycle behavior and implementation path.
